epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time tasks remain in queued or failed status from over 4 hours to under 1 hour
requirements: R1: The system must process and clear tasks in the 'API Slice' and 'Test Coverage' categories that are stuck in failed status.
R2: The system must process tasks in the 'API Slice' and 'Test Coverage' categories that are stuck in queued status for more than 4 hours.
R3: The system must properly update project readiness to resolve the STAGNATION WARNING after unblocking tasks.

slices.title: Backend patch for processing stuck tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the unblocking logic for this epic, I want to patch the task processing service, so that tasks stuck in queued or failed states are resolved and readiness is updated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task in the 'API Slice' category stuck in queued status for over 4 hours
When the processing job runs
Then the task is transitioned appropriately and readiness is updated
Given a task in 'Test Coverage' in a failed state
When the job runs
Then the stagnation state is cleared
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease number of tasks stuck in queued/failed state from current baseline to zero

slices.title: QA coverage for task unblocking logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to add tests for the new unblocking logic, so that the pipeline continues to process tasks without regression.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the task status identification logic
When the test suite executes
Then it successfully identifies tasks queued for > 4 hours
Given integration tests for the task processor
When processing failed tasks
Then the project readiness is verified to change correctly
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test suite missing regression coverage for stagnation states
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase line coverage for task transition logic to 100%
